$comment: Which of the taste checker's checks Synbox keeps (harness/taste.ts). checker: the pinned upstream copy `fetch` verifies. pageKinds: a route's kind (prose, player, admin; any other route is app). flags: the checker's switches, passed when `use` is true. checks: a verdict for every check id the checker reports (adopt, adapt or reject) and the page kinds it applies to (all, app, player, prose, admin). Only adopt and adapt findings on a page of a listed kind are kept. The 2.1.5 app rules have no runnable checker and are not here (DESIGN.md holds them as rules).

flags.reason: captions, effects, hero entrance and dealt moments are marketing rules; visual-empty is lost with them, so broken thumbnails must come from empty-visual and Synbox's own layout audit
invented-contact rules for a local business page
one-section-per-screen rhythm; container-edges and row-lines are adapted and re-checked by Synbox's own audit instead
screen-tile rule for a scrolling landing page
measures marketing sections against their container; app empty states are judged by the states rules instead

photograph-frame timing on a throttled line; thumbnails are judged by Synbox's perf tooling
keep: the sweep finds cut text, spill and overflow between breakpoints
keep the reduced-motion part; the scripts-off walk will fail any SPA and should be read as noise
keep: Synbox already checks safari-narrow at 320
keep: the access block is the most useful part for an app
